charts.title: TOI-6716 b: orbits around TOI-6716
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-6716's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-6716 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Scott et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.547ag070S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SCOTT_ET_AL_2026): P 4.7185898 d

charts.title: TOI-6716 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-6716 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (61, 87, 88) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 112115898, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 4 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 5-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 1 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
